nodes.label: International Relations
nodes.question: In which direction are Russia and the countries of the Caspian area likely to shift their focus regarding energy production and distribution?
nodes.answer: Russia and the countries of the Caspian area are likely to shift their focus toward the East, strengthening production capacity and gas pipelines in relation to China.

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is referred to by "dual-scale" in the context of studying internal frost damage in concrete?
nodes.answer: "Dual-scale" refers to investigations encompassing both macro-scale (above 10 mm) and meso-scale (15 mm) studies.

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What aspect of concrete is lacking experimental studies according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The interactive effects of pre-existing cracks and internal frost damage on concrete are lacking experimental studies.
